notes.title: Perk Update & Tutorial Expansion
notes.content:
Perk Update & Tutorial Expansion

This update brings five brand new perks, an expanded tutorial, and a variety of bug fixes and optimizations to further enhance your gameplay experience.


New Perks

Ghost Cut: All abilities now have 0 base damage but inflict an extra 3 turns of bleeding. Bonus damage effects still apply.

Blood Hunter: Deal +1 extra damage to bleeding enemies.

Toxic Hunter: Deal +1 extra damage to poisoned enemies.

Trapper: When deploying traps, they are now placed both to the left and right, covering a wider area!

Lethal Traps: All traps deal +1 additional damage.



Tutorial Update

Thanks to your feedback, the tutorial has been expanded and improved to help new players.

Bug Fixes & Optimizations

General bug fixes for improved stability.
Minor performance enhancements and polish.
Small UI improvements.



Enjoy experimenting with the new perks!

notes.title: Demo 2.0 is out now!
notes.content:
Demo 2.0 Update: New Level, Enemies, Boss & Abilities!

Demo 2.0 has arrived, bringing a wave of fresh content, visual upgrades, and gameplay improvements.

Discover a Whole New Level with 4 new enemies
Face off against four unique enemies, each with their own special passive abilities. Outsmart them in battle and unlock their powers for yourself!

Challenge a New Boss
A formidable new boss awaits! Defeat them to claim her exclusive abilities.

Unlock 7 New Abilities
Every enemy and boss you defeat grants you brand new abilities to add to your arsenal. Experiment with different combinations and discover powerful new strategies!

Ability System Revamp

You can now equip up to 6 abilities at once.
Sell abilities in the shop area for 10 gold each to make room for new ones.
Your equipped abilities can never exceed 6—choose your favorites carefully!

Visual Enhancements & Post-Processing
Enjoy improved visuals and new post-processing effects that bring the world to life. The game looks better than ever!

Bug Fixes & Quality of Life Improvements

General bug fixes for a smoother, more stable experience.
UI and visual polish for a cleaner look.
Gameplay tweaks for better balance and fun.


Thank You!
Your feedback and support have been crucial in shaping this update. Jump in, try out all the new content, and let us know what you think. More updates are on the horizon!

notes.title: Perk System Update & Quality of Life Improvements
notes.content:
Perk System Update & Quality of Life Improvements
A major new update is here, introducing a dynamic perk system, a new merchant, and a host of gameplay and UI enhancements!

New Feature: Perk System
Perk Merchant: Encounter a new merchant during your runs, offering powerful perks in exchange for currency. Customize your playstyle on the fly and adapt to each run’s unique challenges.

Available Perks:

Backstabber: Deal 1 extra damage when attacking from behind.
Agile Stance: Your first turn-around action each turn is free.
Saboteur: Enemies deal 1 extra damage to each other.
Critical Strike: Abilities have a 33% chance to deal double damage.


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where the Bear Trap ability would sometimes not appear.
Bear Trap now works with all overtime effects and can be swapped during runs without issues.
Addressed several minor bugs and visual glitches.
Minor UI visual updates for a smoother experience.


Quality of Life Changes

Phantom Dash and Bear Trap are now part of your starter kit—no need to purchase them separately (subject to change for full release).
New players now skip the lobby phase and jump straight into the action.
Tweaked sound effects for a more polished audio experience.
Music now plays in a random order, keeping each run feeling fresh.


What’s Ahead
We’re just getting started! Here’s a glimpse at what’s coming soon:


Possible demo extension with more content to explore.
Additional perks to further expand your tactical options.
Continued polish and improvements based on your feedback.


Thank you for playing and supporting the game!

notes.title: UI Visual Update & New Ability
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884702/ff060e521e7523b8403f0d0d31e9487801a13582.gif
Cyberpunk Visual Overhaul & Trap Mechanics
This update introduces significant visual enhancements, new gameplay mechanics, and quality-of-life improvements.

Visual Enhancements
Cyberpunk UI Redesign: The interface has been updated with neon accents, glitch effects to reflect the game’s setting.

Gameplay Updates
New Ability: Bear Trap: Deploy traps and cause enemies to bleed.
Damage-over-Time (DoT) Adjustments: Abilities now apply DoT effects (Bleed, Poison, Electric) even if initial damage is 0.

Bug Fixes & Optimizations
Improved UI transitions.
General performance optimizations and polish.

Upcoming Feature Preview: Perk Progression System
I am pleased to announce the development of a new Perk system, designed to deepen strategic decision-making during gameplay.

Key Details:

In-Run Perk Acquisition: Purchase temporary perks from in-game shops during a run to customize your playstyle.

Strategic Synergies: Perks will interact with existing abilities, damage types, and traps to encourage creative build experimentation.

Roguelike Progression: Unlock persistent upgrades between runs to further refine your tactical approach.

Goals for the System:

Enhanced Replayability: Modular upgrades will diversify viable strategies across playthroughs.

Risk-Reward Balance: Allocate limited resources to perks that align with your immediate challenges or long-term objectives.

notes.title: Visual Update & New Upgrade
notes.content:
Exciting Visual Update Now Live!

I'm thrilled to share the latest update, which brings some fantastic visual enhancements and new gameplay mechanics to the table!

Visual Upgrades:

Tile Lighting: Tiles now light up dynamically depending on whether an enemy or player is standing on them, making it easier to track movements. 
Skill Indicators: When hovering over a skill, the target tiles now light up, so you always know where your abilities will land. 
Environment Animations: Areas have received a fresh visual update with new animations, making the world more immersive. 
Main Menu: The main menu has been completely revamped with sleek new animations for a more polished experience.
Aspect Ratio: The game now playable on ultra wide monitors as well!

Gameplay Enhancements:

New Damage Type - Electric: A new damage type, Electric damage, has been introduced! When an enemy is struck, the electric damage chains to nearby foes, dealing damage to multiple enemies at once. Upgrade Shop: The upgrade shop now offers damage type upgrades, including Bleed, Poison, and Electric. Currently, skills can only be upgraded with one damage type at a time, adding a strategic layer to your choices.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed an issue where skill cooldowns would randomly reset to their original values.
Resolved a bug that allowed players to use skills outside of their turn.
Various minor bug fixes and polish to improve overall gameplay.

notes.title: New Difficulties Update
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce a new update that introduces difficulty levels!

How it works

Everyone starts at the "Apprentice" difficulty.
Completing the demo will now unlock the next difficulty tier.

The Difficulty Levels:

Apprentice: Most enemies have their passives disabled.
Specialist: Some enemies have more health, and most passives are enabled.
Operative: Player health is reduced. Even tougher enemies with amplified passives.
Secret Difficulty: Can you reach it?

Bug Fixes:

Resolved issues with wave spawning that caused players to get stuck.
Fixed the timer bug to display the correct run time.
Addressed problems with damage over time effects not working properly.
Corrected the issue of players starting with more skills than intended.

Polish and Improvements:

Various minor polishes to enhance gameplay.

notes.title: New Shop and Potion
notes.content:
I am excited to announce that the demo has just been updated with some fantastic new features and improvements!

New Potion: Introducing "Lightning in a Bottle" - this new potion stuns every enemy for 1 round when used.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884702/91a15631fe9543a82e10aa1184093d4150b3a8a3.gif

New Shop: The Potion Shop is now open! You can purchase a variety of potions here. Additionally, you can now sell your potions in the shop area.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884702/5777c52307c1b0082b897e9f5f9d8b3e70533037.gif

Excess Potions: Any potions dropped that don't fit in your inventory will now be converted to gold on the spot. Note that this conversion yields slightly less gold than selling the potion directly.

Gameplay Changes:

The next wave of enemies will spawn after a few turns if there's space for them, eliminating stalling tactics.
Balancing Updates: The demo boss can now summon Blade Masters.
The Keen Observer passive has been changed. Instead of granting 1 action, it now grants 1 damage when triggered.
Quality of Life: You can now drink health potions whenever you want.

Bugfixes:

Fixed an issue where the player could sometimes get stuck.

Try out these new features and let us know what you think! Your feedback is invaluable in shaping the future of the game.
